heal_events.prompt: Most product cards are returning image_url as null - only 1 of 13 products had an image. Each product card in the collection grid contains a product photo (a cdn.shopify.com image). Re-locate the primary product image inside every product card and populate image_url with its absolute URL for every row. Keep all existing fields unchanged.
heal_events.detail: Approved without --auto-save — never persisted. Also the wrong tool: grid images are lazy-loaded, so the URL is absent from the DOM the run sees.

heal_events.prompt: image_url is still null for 45 of 49 products after the previous fix. The product images on this Shopify collection grid are LAZY-LOADED: the img tag's src attribute is empty or a placeholder until the card scrolls into view, and the real image URL lives in the data-src, data-srcset or srcset attribute of the img (or in the parent noscript/picture element). Read the image URL from data-src/srcset instead of src, take the first URL from any srcset candidate list, prefix protocol-relative //cdn.shopify.com URLs with https:, and set image_url for EVERY product row. Verify on more than one product card, not just the first.
heal_events.detail: Targeted lazy-loading explicitly. Also approved without --auto-save. Image coverage was ultimately fixed outside the collector via /products/{handle}.json.

heal_events.prompt: The discount_percent field is being returned as a string like "63% OFF" or "37% OFF". Change it to return a plain integer number instead: 63, 37. Strip the percent sign and the word OFF, and output discount_percent as a numeric JSON value, not a string, for every product row. If no discount is shown for a product, return null. Do not change any other field.
heal_events.detail: Approved without --auto-save, so the template was never persisted. Steps ended at user_approval; no save_new_template. Real run: 0/49 numeric.
